# SE04 XChaCha20-Poly1305 v1 fixture

This directory is the canonical byte-level conformance corpus for SE04. Its
consumer tests run the same records through the Rust, Python, Go, TypeScript,
Ruby, and Elixir implementations.

`cases.json` contains:

- the draft Section 2.2.1 HChaCha20 subkey vector;
- raw XChaCha20 outputs for counters 0 and 1 over the same multi-block input;
- the draft Appendix A.3.1 AEAD vector;
- deterministic empty and 257-byte multi-block AEAD vectors; and
- mutations for ciphertext, key, nonce tail, AAD, and every tag byte, all of
  which must produce the single public `authentication_failed` result without
  plaintext.

All byte strings are lowercase hexadecimal with two characters per byte.
`schema.json` closes the v1 field names, sizes, operations, and mutation
vocabulary. Fixture parsing is test-only; the six packages retain zero runtime
dependencies.

The draft vectors are copied from the construction pinned by SE04. The extra
raw, empty, and multi-block outputs were generated by the Python implementation
and must be reproduced byte-for-byte by all six independently implemented
packages before they are accepted.
